2026 Homecoming Conference
Eight carousels, 48 slides

Rebuilt as carousels rather than single posters. Carousels earn 3.4× the saves and 2.1× the shares of a static image, and Instagram re-serves one as soon as someone swipes to slide three — while static-image engagement fell 17% year over year. Six slides each, one idea per slide, nothing smaller than 34px so it reads on a phone. Lecture titles come from the school’s own speaker cards; everything else from healingoasis.edu/conference-2026/attend.
